Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Intern position at Endoo. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web design, I am excited about the opportunity to learn and contribute to your marketing efforts from brief to launch.

At Episto, I have been responsible for on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and WordPress site builds, which has given me a solid foundation in practical marketing. My own project, mirook.com, has allowed me to apply structured data and GEO techniques to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. I am eager to bring this technical and creative mix to Endoo, working closely with your managing partner and sales team.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am available for an internship. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a B1 level in Dutch and improving.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Endoo's marketing projects.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing Intern position at Endoo. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO, I am drawn to Endoo's approach of building Odoo implementations and AI products that fit how clients actually work. I am eager to learn how marketing works in the real world, and I believe my hands-on experience and proactive attitude align well with the responsibilities you describe.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content creation, and WordPress site management. I have learned to track performance using tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console, and to use data to guide decisions. This has taught me the importance of understanding the audience and measuring impact—skills that are directly relevant to supporting your marketing campaigns.

Beyond my professional experience, I have built mirook.com from scratch, a project that showcases my ability to handle a project from concept to launch. I designed and built the site, implemented structured data and entity optimization, and ran iterative SEO/GEO audits to improve its visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project has given me a taste of taking ownership and seeing a project through, which I am ready to bring to Endoo.

I am particularly excited about the opportunity to work directly with your managing partner and sales team, and to learn from a senior salesperson. I am a quick learner, comfortable with new tools, and eager to take on real responsibility. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am available for an internship.

Thank you for considering my application. I would love the chance to discuss how I can contribute to Endoo's marketing efforts.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
